# ListenerRolloff <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [3D Sound](Blitz3D-3D-Sound)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ListenerRolloff:Void value:Float32, fade_ms:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | In | Float32 | required | `0` means sounds do not get quieter with distance, `1` is the normal rate and above that makes them fade faster. Below 0 is a runtime error. |
| `fade_ms` | In | Int32 | `0` | How many milliseconds it takes to get to the new value. `0` (the default) changes it at once. Below 0 is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Changes how fast 3D sounds get quiet with distance, which [CreateListener](CreateListener) sets first. The change can glide over a time, so that walking from a cave into the open does not change every sound at once. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* It works without a listener too, for the one at the origin that is there until [CreateListener](CreateListener) is called. A new value while one glides starts from where it has got to. [GetListenerRolloff](GetListenerRolloff) tells the value.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
; Out of the cave, sounds carry further: half the rolloff over two seconds.
ListenerRolloff 0.5, 2000
```
